title: No enums anywhere: correct for ABI extensibility
description: Algorithm and provider identification uses strings ('cbc(aes)', 'wolfssl'), never enum values or integer IDs. This allows new algorithms to be registered by out-of-tree providers without any header change or userspace recompile. An enum-based dispatch would freeze the algorithm namespace at compile time. No flag bits appear in any ioctl struct for the same reason: flags accumulate untestable combinations. A reviewer who suggests 'add an enum for efficiency' is wrong.
close_reason: Decision recorded. No enums in UAPI — no code change needed.
